entries.reason: Windows refused background foreground focus while ChatGPT was foreground; bounded focus retry did not relaunch.
entries.resolution: Stopped and freshly closed the owned target; acquisition-only reproduction proved two visible targets under one grant.

entries.reason: Installer correctly refused missing/incorrect state marker and missing dedicated startup directory; PowerShell 7 launcher environment differs from the accepted Windows PowerShell shortcut.
entries.resolution: Prepared disposable state with actual Host/Mission migrations and correct layout marker, own startup folder; used Windows PowerShell 5.1. No production switch.

entries.reason: Harness tried mission.stop after completion; Host correctly refused the transition.
entries.resolution: Controller checks terminal state before Stop; safely recovered the exact owned target and reran reuse.

entries.reason: TTL elapsed during native validation of an admitted action; contained step failure needs explicit retry rather than automatic next request.
entries.resolution: Retained failure, safely cleaned fixture; tested real explicit retry/fresh approval, one launch and same target.

entries.reason: Initial assumption that Calculator was not foreground was false; minimizing hides the UWP arithmetic subtree, causing readiness pause and owned cleanup refusal.
entries.resolution: Explicit minimization, observed pause/no new runs; restored only the owned HWND using fresh frame/content/package checks and revalidated UIA. Fresh approval reused the target. Previous failed fixture safely restored then freshly closed; close authority unchanged.

entries.reason: Renderer uses null, not undefined, for absent batch offer. Product correctly required separate approval.
entries.resolution: Changed harness assertion only, proved fresh acquisition-run ownership for failed fixture cleanup; rerun required separate Notepad approval and executed zero other-app runs.

entries.reason: Bundled Playwright Chromium headless shell is absent.
entries.resolution: Same repository smoke runner passed with installed Microsoft Edge; both screenshots visually inspected, clean console and no overflow.
